rationale: The Court is most likely to issue a narrow, unanimous opinion (assigned by the Chief) holding that States lack authority to enforce Section 3 against presidential candidates through state-court ballot-exclusion proceedings absent a uniform federal enforcement mechanism under Section 5. Separate concurrences are most likely from originalist/pragmatic blocs (e.g., Thomas/Alito/Kavanaugh/Barrett) to elaborate on Griffin’s Case, self-execution, and the Article II/Twelfth Amendment uniformity/workability concerns while avoiding the merits of whether Trump engaged in insurrection.
